displayIdentity.body: Paul appeals to Caesar before Festus. Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea. Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, “You have appealed to Caesar. To Caesar you shall go.”
displayIdentity.title: Paul appeals to Caesar before Festus
